gloss: pretending to be out; feigning absence

definitions.gloss: pretending to be out; feigning absence
definitions.explanation: The act of being at home but pretending not to be, typically to avoid answering the door or dealing with a visitor.

examples.japanese: {居留守|いるす}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{居留守|いるす}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: A stranger came, so I pretended not to be home.

examples.japanese: セールスマン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧たび⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{居留守|いるす}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{来|こ}なくなった。
examples.english: Since I pretend to be out every time a salesperson comes, they've stopped coming lately.

notes:
A uniquely expressive Japanese word with no direct English equivalent. Composed of {居|い}る (to be present) + ⟦{留守|るす}→留守：01754_rusu⟧ (being away from home) — a paradoxical compound meaning "to be present but absent." Almost exclusively used in the set phrase {居留守|いるす}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {居留守|いるす}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to pretend to be out
- {居留守|いるす}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}め{込|こ}む→決め込む：13343_kimekomu⟧: to firmly pretend to be out (more emphatic)

USAGE:
Most commonly used when avoiding door-to-door salespeople, unwanted visitors, or debt collectors. The act is considered slightly dishonest but widely understood and practiced. Modern intercom systems with cameras have made {居留守|いるす} easier — you can check who is at the door before deciding whether to answer.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{留守|るす}→留守：01754_rusu⟧: absence from home — genuinely being away, not pretending
- ⟦{留守番|るすばん}→留守番：15546_rusuban⟧: house-sitting; staying home to watch the house — actively staying home while others are out
